MAQCS

planqc

MAQCS

planqc · neutral atoms · PLANNED / under construction (first hardware at LRZ since 9-10 Sep 2026; operation as an HPC co-processor by end-2027) (Sep 2026 (hardware delivered); end-2027 (operation)) · 1000 physical qubits · access: on-prem (LRZ, DLR Ulm)
architecture: מערך פינצטות רידברג — אלקליים-עפרוריים (Yb/Sr), מחיקה מובנית · Open on the map

Register profile — the machine's variant of its architecture

qubit type: strontium optical clock-transition qubit - coherence 10-100 ms, three orders below the hyperfine figures in the same layer
gate mechanism: Rydberg-blockade CZ; >60 coherent Rabi cycles
connectivity: atoms held in a regular grid by an optical lattice ("an egg carton made of light") rather than individually placed tweezers; multi-core with sequential atom reloading
control: lattice + Rydberg laser control
control placement: optics (room temperature)
readout: fluorescence imaging
flags: no published error rates

Technologies by layer — the machine's cell per layer
